_comment: Input for build_idm_xlsx.py. This example reproduces the reference Portal4_Новые продукты_IDM.numbers. The skill assembles a spec like this from the interview answers, then runs: python3 build_idm_xlsx.py --spec <this>.
_environments_comment: One block per deployment contour. 'key' goes into the AD group name (KC-Role-<app>-<key>-<role>). 'display_prefix' starts the 'Наименование доступа' cell. 'contour_phrase' is substituted into each role description at the {contour} marker (leading space included; empty for prod).
_roles_comment: 'name' is the machine role (lowercased into the AD group). 'human_name' fills 'Наименование доступа'. The {contour} marker in 'description' is replaced per environment. The three flags accept true/false or Да/Нет.

roles.name: cookies-shop-user
roles.description: Данная роль предоставляет права пользователя сервиса пряничной лавки системы Portal 4.0{contour}.

roles.name: cookies-shop-admin
roles.description: Данная роль предоставляет права администратора сервиса пряничной лавки системы Portal 4.0{contour}.
